options.title: RUNGS AND RAILS (DRAFT)
options.line: two straight rails and a flat rung every five pixels, outlined, lit rail left, its foot on its own shadow -- reads as a ladder at a glance

options.title: ROPE AND SLATS (DRAFT)
options.line: a rope ladder: two twisted ropes and wide slats lashed across them, lit on top, shaded under

options.title: PEG POLE (DRAFT)
options.line: one stout pole with pegs driven in left and right, turn about -- a climber's pole, the same gold

options.title: BROKEN LIP (DRAFT)
options.line: an uneven lip in the place's own rim colour, the far wall seen falling away inside, the near edge lit -- a drop, not a black disc

options.title: STEPPED SHAFT (DRAFT)
options.line: a round shaft that steps down in rings -- rim, wall, a ledge, wall -- to a smaller black: deep

options.title: SPLINTERED (DRAFT)
options.line: a jagged break with cracks running out into the floor, as if it gave way under someone

objects.what: the ice hole (0x35B, after cracked ice)

options.title: GLARE AND GLINT (DRAFT)
options.line: polished ice: deeper cyan, a soft-edged white glare and a thin one across every block, and a four-point glint -- slippery at a glance

options.title: SKATE-SCORED (DRAFT)
options.line: pale ice scored with long curved blade marks, a rink someone has already slid across

options.title: FACETS (DRAFT)
options.line: the ice cut into flat facets, each lit its own way with a fine seam between -- glassy, less slippery

options.title: IN KEEPING (DRAFT)
options.line: each last piece drawn in its place's approved look: boards on the harbour's red, the spa's ripples, embers in the steps, berries in clusters, a press plate, lit pebbles

options.title: QUIET (DRAFT)
options.line: the same pieces with one mark each instead of several -- the least drawing that is no longer pret's

objects.what: a boulder on ice, its lit cap (0x347)
